text: Lesson 8's joined extract is sitting in a pandas dataframe. Before anyone engineers a single feature, this video actually looks at it -- churned accounts against active ones, side by side.
Tenure tells the clearest story so far: active accounts run a median tenure near 540 days, churned accounts closer to 210. Customers who make it past year one are far more likely to stay.
Smaller accounts and entry-level plan tiers churn more. Support ticket volume is weaker than the team expected at the median -- the real signal only shows up in the heaviest-ticket tail.
Invoice lateness is clearly elevated among churned accounts. None of this gets built into a model feature yet -- that's deliberately next lesson's job, not this one's.
A short findings note goes to Dana before anything gets engineered. Next: turning what's real here into the actual feature set.
